title: Five Weeks. Now Build The Life | A Discipline Short Film
lines: The habit is built. Now comes the bigger part.
Discipline was never the goal. It was the tool.
Now use it. Build the career. The body. The life you pictured.
You already proved you can do hard things.
So aim higher. Ask for more. Become more.
This isn't the end of the journey. It's the foundation.
